AvailabilitySearchRequest.description: Availability search criteria with date range and filters

charged.description: True when the saved card was charged. A declined or undecided charge answers 200 with charged=false and the report stays ASSESSED so the charge can be retried.

byCurrency.description: Monetary totals grouped by the currency each report was assessed in; amounts of different currencies are never summed together. Reports not yet assessed carry no currency and are not listed.

field.description: Request field the message applies to

title.description: Short summary of the HTTP status

notes.description: Notes about car condition at pickup
Notes about car condition at return

dailyRate.description: Effective price per day in the car currency. For a request without dates this is the price of a single day starting today. For a request with dates it is the total price divided by the number of rental days in that range.

totalPrice.description: Total price in the car currency for the priced range: one day when the request has no dates, otherwise the whole requested range.

damageCostByCurrency.description: Customer damage liability grouped by assessment currency; amounts of different currencies are never summed together.

spentByCurrency.description: Net amount paid for the rentals of the user (rental, late-return penalty and damage payments, after refunds), grouped by currency; amounts of different currencies are never summed together.
